summary: The same record list inside a narrow slot, to show it stacking because the list reads its own width.
use: Checking how a dense record list reads on a phone before shipping it, without resizing the browser.
spec: 2 rows from `keys` (Production key, CI pipeline) with `<Avatar alt={key.name} size="sm" />` in `{#snippet identity()}`
`<RecordCell label="Prefix">`, `<RecordCell label="Last used">` and `<RecordCell label="Created">`; `{#snippet actions()}` holds a `<DropdownMenu align="end">` with a `Revoke` item
